communications.subject: RE: [EXTERNAL] Colorado Open Records Act Request: CORA Request - Easement (Denver City Council)
communications.communication:
Good morning,

Thank you for your records request. We cannot complete your request as submitted.


  1.  The Denver City Council is the legislative body for the city. It is not generally involved in the day-to-day operations of the city. We can only search records within our custody. As such, we are not the custodian of, nor do we have access to, the email accounts for any employee outside the City Council.
  2.  While we can use the search terms you provided, we have no way of knowing who works in the offices you mentioned. This includes the Denver Mayor's Office, Denver Economic Development and Opportunity, or the Department of Community Planning and Development.
  3.  To proceed, you must give us the email accounts you wish to search and the keywords you wish to use. A few points to keep in mind:
     *   If you wish to search all emails within the City Council offices, that will be 65 separate individuals, which can dramatically increase the time and cost.
     *   Also, the city’s email retention policy is 30 days, so emails from that era may not exist (although we can certainly search), and we do not have access to former employees' emails.
  4.  Note that any actions taken by the City Council are public records and can be searched at https://denver.legistar.com/Legislation.aspx.
  5.  Specifically, the easement relinquishment  you refer to for the addresses you gave can be found here, including all supporting documents: https://denver.legistar.com/LegislationDetail.aspx?ID=6378457&GUID=1C471438-CEA6-44F6-A29F-5154B9A81AE3&Options=ID|Text|Attachments|&Search=%224900+N+Race+Street%22
  6.  The city’s CORA policy allows for one free hour to search, gather, and review responsive records that are releasable under CORA. Time beyond that hour has a fee of $41.37/hour, and payment is required before we can begin.
  7.  If you can clarify the above information for your request,  I will give you a time and cost estimate for completing a search.

Please let me know if you have any questions. I’m also happy to discuss your request by phone if needed.

Have a great day!

Robert
